text: Twenty thirty-six. Ten years from now. Go to Kerala. More than one in every five people there... is over sixty. Picture a grandmother in a big house. Four bedrooms. Three of them locked. Her son is in Dubai. Her daughter, in Bengaluru. On Sunday, the phone rings. That's the family visit.
